errors.error_description: The combinational always block uses a manual sensitivity list that omits signals read inside (addr, op_class, format_mask, gate_mask), leading to a mismatch between simulation and synthesized hardware.
An escaped identifier named \logic is declared and used as a signal, improperly repurposing a SystemVerilog reserved keyword as an identifier.
A deeply nested if-else tree is used to derive op_class from opcode instead of a simpler case or arithmetic mapping, creating an unnecessarily long combinational path.
